) said on Friday that it received a notice regarding non-compliance with the New York Stock Exchange's continued listing standards.

According to the notice, as of October 28, 2026, the 30 trading-day average market capitalization of the company was about $48.4M and the last reported stockholders’ deficit as of June 30, 2026, was nearly $4.3M, both below the $50M NYSE threshold.
The company said that it has notified the NYSE it will submit a plan within the stipulated timeline on steps it will take to regain compliance.

title: Annovis Bio gets non-compliance notice from NYSE
